title: Scaling LLM Training Using RDMA over Converged Ethernet
problem: InfiniBand traditional for HPC but expensive; RoCE offers cost-effective alternative but scaling performance unclear
motivation: Large-scale LLM training demands high-bandwidth networking; commodity Ethernet + RDMA provides cost savings
method: Comprehensive benchmarking comparing RoCE vs. InfiniBand; studies data sharding, quantization, recomputation, batch sizing, optimizations
key_novelty: Demonstrates RoCE achieves near-linear scaling comparable to InfiniBand under proper configuration
contributions: Benchmarks RoCE scaling for LLM training
Provides guidance on data sharding strategies
